title: Final epilogue line 'Tamsin never got to Cinderhall with you. The mine keeps its answer, and she keeps swinging at whatever is nearest.' directly contradicts the playthrough: Tamsin traveled to Cinderhall with the party, stood vigil at 'The Hundred Gallery — Deep' ('Tamsin stops just inside the door... This is it'), and approved multiple times on-site, including 'You've earned my back in a fight.' A different epilogue line in the same status screen ('You told Tamsin to make them answer for the mine. She did...') correctly reflects this, so the two lines actively contradict each other.
where: final status / epilogue line about Tamsin and Cinderhall

evidence.quote: The final status epilogue states 'Tamsin never got to Cinderhall with you. The mine keeps its answer, and she keeps swinging at whatever is nearest' — but Tamsin was physically present when I resolved 'The Hundred' at The Hundred Gallery — Deep ('Tamsin stops just inside the door... This is it, she says'), the quest is logged as Done, and she gave me a permanent perk (Re-tempered Edge) specifically because of that resolution ('You told me to make them answer for it. I did. This edge remembers that too.'). The epilogue directly contradicts a major, correctly-logged story beat.
